news.title: Jr NTR Boosts Hype for Fahadh Faasil's Upcoming Release
news.summary: Jr NTR recently lent star power to a promotional event for the Fahadh Faasil-starrer Don't Trouble The Trouble, produced by SS Karthikeya. His appearance successfully generated social media buzz ahead of the movie's October 2 release. Industry experts note, however, that positive word-of-mouth will ultimately decide the content-driven project's box-office fate.

news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee's Massive Project Considers Two-Part Strategy
news.summary: Icon Star Allu Arjun is currently immersed in filming his high-budget venture Raaka, directed by Atlee and backed by Sun Pictures. Given the substantial production costs and international technical standards, the makers are discussing a two-part theatrical release schedule for December 2027 and 2028. The star-studded cast features Deepika Padukone, Rashmika Mandanna, Mrunal Thakur, Janhvi Kapoor, and Aishwarya Lekshmi.

news.title: Multiple Multilingual Titles Gear Up for Gandhi Jayanthi Weekend
news.summary: A total of eight feature films across various languages are lined up for theatrical distribution during the Gandhi Jayanthi holiday weekend. Key arrivals include the Fahadh Faasil vehicle Don't Trouble The Trouble, Roshan's Tella Kagitham, Vikram Sahadev's Anakapalli, and Sundeep Kishan's bilingual actioner Sigma. Several other regional and dubbed projects are also entering cinemas during this festive window.

news.title: Ravi Teja Starrer Irumudi Captures Top Spot on Netflix Global Charts
news.summary: Ravi Teja's blockbuster hit Irumudi has surged to the number one position on the Netflix Global Top 10 charts for Non-English films for the week of September 21-27, 2026. The Shiva Nirvana directorial pulled in 3.4 lakh views during the tracking week to overtake previous leaders. Bankrolled by Mythri Movie Makers, the movie also stars Priya Bhavani Shankar, Sai Kumar, and features music by GV Prakash Kumar.

news.title: Sreeleela Starts Filming for Rajinikanth's Dharman in Mysuru
news.summary: Actress Sreeleela has joined the production of Rajinikanth's upcoming film Dharman, directing her attention to Tamil cinema alongside her role in Dhanush's OM. She was recently spotted at the shoot location in Mysuru, where she requested onlookers to stop filming her on mobile phones. Directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and produced by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, the movie also stars Ram Pothineni and Raashi Khanna.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya Gears Up for His Milestone 25th Project
news.summary: As Naga Chaitanya prepares for the December release of his big-budget mystical thriller Vrushakarma, directed by Karthik Dandu Varma, he is simultaneously setting up his next milestone movie. Producer Bunny Vas is funding his 25th film, presented by Allu Aravind, with Bedurulanka fame Clax locked in to direct. The official launch for this upcoming venture is scheduled for October.

news.title: Rumors Spark About Allu Arjun's Character in Lokesh Kanagaraj Collaboration
news.summary: Speculation is swirling around the highly anticipated pan-India project AA23, uniting Allu Arjun and director Lokesh Kanagaraj, with rumors hinting that the actor might play multiple roles including a police officer. Although the makers have not given official confirmation regarding these character details, the production involves Mythri Movie Makers with music by Anirudh Ravichander. Allu Arjun is currently occupied with Atlee's Raaka before moving on to this venture.

news.title: Anand Deverakonda Starrer Epic - First Semester Eyes October OTT Premiere
news.summary: Following an underwhelming box office theatrical run, Sithara Entertainments' Epic - First Semester is reportedly planning a digital streaming debut on October 9, 2026. Directed by debutant Aditya Hasan and starring Anand Deverakonda alongside Vaishnavi Chaitanya, the film could potentially stream in multiple languages. An official announcement regarding the digital release is still pending.

news.title: September 2026 Box Office Struggles with Nani's The Paradise as the Exception
news.summary: The Telugu film industry faced a largely disappointing box office run throughout September 2026, with numerous releases failing to recover their theatrical investments. Nani's "The Paradise" emerged as the month's highest-grossing release, pulling in around Rs 150 crore worldwide despite facing harsh reviews and negative campaigns. Most other mid-sized and dubbed offerings struggled to capture audience attention, leaving the month underperforming overall.

news.title: Glimpses from the Pre-Release Event of Dont Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: The pre-release gathering for "Dont Trouble The Trouble" drew considerable attention as prominent film personalities and artists made glamorous appearances. Photographs from the venue captured the lively atmosphere and the excitement surrounding the upcoming cinematic project. The event served as a major promotional highlight for the film.

news.title: Jr NTR Returns to Public Events in High Spirits Following Injury Recovery
news.summary: Actor Jr NTR made a cheerful and composed appearance as the chief guest for the "Dont Trouble The Trouble" pre-release event after a long hiatus caused by an injury. Addressing the attendees, he confirmed that he has nearly recovered and will soon resume shooting for his upcoming film "Dragon", keeping its planned June 11, 2027 release date on track. Fans warmly welcomed his relaxed demeanor, which contrasted with his more serious public appearances in the past.

news.title: Mythri Movie Makers Face Financial Pressure Over Delayed High-Budget Projects
news.summary: Prominent production banner Mythri Movie Makers is navigating heavy financial stakes due to major delays and ballooning budgets on two high-profile ventures: Prabhas's periodic film "Fauzi" and Jr NTR's "Dragon" directed by Prashanth Neel. Both productions have crossed their initial financial estimates and missed early release timelines, placing significant pressure on the studio to secure strong theatrical returns.

news.title: NTR and Prashanth Neel's Action Drama Locks June 2027 Premiere
news.summary: Producer Ravi Shankar of Mythri Movie Makers has dismissed postponement rumours and confirmed that the action entertainer Dragon, starring NTR and directed by Prashanth Neel, will release on June 11, 2027. NTR is set to resume filming heavy action sequences starting October 10, with shooting scheduled to run continuously through February 2027. The movie features NTR as an assassin named Luger alongside a supporting cast including Anil Kapoor, Rukmini Vasanth, and Biju Menon.

news.title: Khushboo's Traditional First Look Revealed for Mahakali The End
news.summary: Makers of the Prashanth Varma Cinematic Universe project Mahakali The End have unveiled a homely first look of senior actress Khushboo to celebrate her birthday. Directed by Puja Aparna Kolluru and backed by Riwaz Ramesh Duggal, the West Bengal-set film features Akshaye Khanna as Shukracharya, Bhumi Pednekar as the female lead, and Rohit Saraf in a key role. Netflix has already secured the high-profile project's digital streaming rights.

news.title: Karthik Subbaraj Reveals Direct-to-Netflix Film Featuring Upendra and Prabhu Deva
news.summary: While promoting the upcoming Telugu release of his directorial Dorothy, filmmaker Karthik Subbaraj announced his next project will debut directly on Netflix. Based on a novel about Puliyattam, the venture features Upendra, Prabhu Deva, and Atharva in major roles. Production is already underway, with a portion of the movie quietly filmed ahead of official crew announcements.

news.title: Leaked Clip Sparks Sudden Curiosity For Harsh Roshan's Thella Kagitham
news.summary: Harsh Roshan's upcoming movie Thella Kagitham has captured public attention following an unexpected online leak of a bold sequence. Directed by Ramesh Badreddy and co-starring Nakshatra, the youthful romantic drama is now leveraging this sudden wave of social media buzz ahead of its theatrical release.

news.title: Fahadh Faasil Starrer Dont Trouble The Trouble Set To Release As A Family Entertainer
news.summary: Fahadh Faasil is making his direct Telugu film debut in Dont Trouble The Trouble, directed by Sashank Yeleti and slated for an October 2nd release. Backed by producer Karthikeya and featuring music by Kala Bhairava, the family-friendly entertainer promises a wholesome cinematic experience for all audience segments.

news.title: Urvashi Rautela Initiates Massive Legal Action Against US AI Firm
news.summary: Bollywood actress Urvashi Rautela has reportedly pursued damages amounting to Rs 7,000 crores against an unnamed Los Angeles-based artificial intelligence firm over the alleged unauthorized commercial exploitation of her identity. Her legal team firmly asserted that her name, images, and videos cannot be utilized for business purposes without explicit permission.

news.title: NTR Shines Spotlight On Dont Trouble The Trouble At Pre-Release Event
news.summary: Jr NTR graced the pre-release event of Dont Trouble The Trouble as the chief guest, lending massive support to lead actor Fahadh Faasil and producer Karthikeya. During the gathering, NTR delivered an emotional speech highlighting his deep bond with Karthikeya and wished the entire team a massive blockbuster success.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya's 25th Movie Pairs Him with Debutante Saatvika Veeravalli
news.summary: Actor Naga Chaitanya is moving forward with his milestone 25th cinematic project, which will be directed by Clax. Newcomer Saatvika Veeravalli has been selected to star opposite the actor as the female lead.

news.title: Jr NTR Joins Rajamouli's Family for an Emotional Pre-Release Event in Hyderabad
news.summary: The grand pre-release gathering for Dont Trouble The Trouble turned into a heartfelt reunion as Jr NTR joined director SS Rajamouli and his family members. The event celebrated the production debut of Rajamouli's son Karthikeya for the Shasank Yeleti directorial venture starring Fahadh Faasil.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya Locks Musical Love Story for Landmark 25th Project
news.summary: Following his upcoming venture Vrushakarma, Naga Chaitanya has officially signed a musical love story for his 25th film directed by Clax. The project will be jointly backed by Geetha Arts, Annapurna Studios, and Bunny Vas, with principal photography slated to begin in December 2026.

news.title: Trivikram Clarifies Title Status for Upcoming Mythological Drama with Jr NTR
news.summary: Director Trivikram has confirmed that while the script for his next mythological project with Jr NTR is fully prepared, an official title has not been locked yet. Dismissing active rumors about the title, the filmmaker noted that pre-production will commence soon for the venture produced by Haarika & Hassine Creations and NTR Arts.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address The Paradise Dialogue Debate
news.summary: Director Srikanth Odela and actor Nani have responded to the audience backlash regarding a controversial mother-daughter scene in their recent release, The Paradise. While Srikanth explained that the mother's shocking words stemmed from sudden amazement at her daughter's talent, Nani acknowledged that a weaker setup caused the emotional payoff to miss the mark with viewers.

news.title: Breezy Melody Emo Emo Idi Released from Sailesh Kolanu Project
news.summary: The makers of Emo Emo Idi have dropped the romantic title track featuring Roshan Meka and Preity Mukhundhan against snowy mountain backdrops. Composed by Hesham Abdul Wahab with vocals by Karthik and Ramya Behara, the film is directed by Dr. Sailesh Kolanu and slated for an October 30, 2026 theatrical release.

news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Crunch as Streaming Platforms Cut Budgets
news.summary: The Telugu film industry is confronting a severe streaming market crisis as digital platforms aggressively slash budgets and refuse inflated asking prices from producers. With payouts now increasingly tied to box office results, filmmakers may soon have to rely entirely on theatrical revenues. Observers believe this financial tightening could push producers to prioritize controlled budgets and better content quality.

news.title: Jr NTR and Trivikram's Mythological Project Script Completed
news.summary: Director Trivikram has confirmed that the full script is ready for his upcoming mythological collaboration with Jr NTR centered around Lord Murugan. Set to begin production in 2027, the film will feature music by Anirudh and is backed by producers S. Radha Krishna and Kalyan Ram.

news.title: Trivikram Confirms Script Lock for Epic Mythological Project with NTR
news.summary: Director Trivikram revealed that the script for his upcoming high-budget mythological film starring NTR has been locked, though the official title remains unannounced. While NTR is currently busy filming Prashanth Neel's Dragon, Trivikram is occupied with promotions for his upcoming directorial venture Aadarsha Kutumbam. Once pre-production wraps up following Aadarsha Kutumbam's theatrical run, the massive collaborative project under Haarika and Hassine Creations is eyeing a 2028 release.

news.title: Satyadev's Ecological Action Thriller Samavarthi Generates Massive Buzz
news.summary: Actor Satyadev's upcoming film Samavarthi, directed by Ajay Nag V, has captured audience attention as its teaser crossed the one-crore digital views milestone. Playing the rugged protagonist Mahadev in this ecological action thriller, Satyadev's 16th lead project has also sparked heightened interest from business circles. Backed by Rudra Pictures and Panchabhuta Productions, the movie aims for a release later this year across multiple south Indian languages.

news.title: Strong Audience Response Amplifies Commercial Interest for Samavarthi
news.summary: The promotional campaign for Satyadev's upcoming ecological action drama Samavarthi has received a major boost following the successful launch of its teaser. Garnering positive reactions from viewers, the gripping preview has successfully driven up trade inquiries and overall anticipation for the film. The project is slated to hit screens in multiple languages later this year.
